comment: The frequency is held to half the sample rate, PHSR.cpp:58. An output with no cable in it is not computed at all, PHSR.cpp:63, PHSR.cpp:88 and PHSR.cpp:101. With the Square menu item on, the Phsr output carries 0V to 10V rather than -5V to 5V, PHSR.cpp:71. The DC blockers for the Sin and Tri outputs are indexed by channel rather than by group of four, PHSR.cpp:96 and PHSR.cpp:109, so with more than four channels those outputs use blockers that belong to other channels.
